claims.claim: A registered public key may issue credentials
Two root key IDs necessarily represent two independent authorities
A predecessor chain alone prevents offline rollback
A local file anchor protects rollback of both bundle and anchor storage
Rotation, targeted revocation, offline import and single-store rollback detection are locally exercised
Time-effective key revocation can preserve valid historical evidence while blocking later trust

limitations: Signatures prove authorization and material binding, not truth or legal independence.
The independent file anchor detects rollback of the bundle store alone; joint rollback of bundle and anchor remains unprotected without external monotonic storage, HSM or federation.
The proof is single-host and uses local test keys; PostgreSQL, KMS/HSM, live provider and human value are not qualified.
